Maharashtra Through P.S.O. ... on 19 October, 2023

Author: M. W. Chandwani

 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur.

 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Criminal Application (Apl) No. 1452 Of 2023
 Bharat S/o. Shivandas Kamnani and others
 Vs.
 State of Maharashtra and another
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Court's or
 Coram, appearances, Court's Orders
 or directions and Registrar's order
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Shri D. P. Singh, Advocate for applicants.
Shri Neeraj Jawde, App for non-applicant no. 1/State.

Coram :- Vinay Joshi &
 M. W. Chandwani, Jj.
 Dated :- 19.10.2023
 Heard.

2.  This is an application for seeking quashing of the First Information Report in Crime No.
1201/2023 registered with Awdhootwadi Police Station, District Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Sections 420 and 406 r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the applicants would submit that there was private monetary transaction between the parties however, the informant has given different colour to it by making fictitious story.

To support his contention, the applicants have produced a copy of the notice dated 13.05.2023 issued by the Police in terms of Section 160 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, which bears a reference to the transaction preceding the date stated by the informant.

Moreover, the applicants have RR Jaiswal 2 912-apl-1452-23.odt produced certain documents to show that the said transaction was made for a different purpose but, the informant has shown it for different purpose.

Bharat S/O Shivandas Kamnani And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra Through P.S.O. ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35493060/
1 4.
Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable on 30.11.2023.

5. The learned APP waives service of notice for non-applicant no. 1/State.
6.
In the meantime, the investigation may go on but, charge-sheet shall not be filed without obtaining leave of the Court.
(M. W. CHANDWANI, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) Signed by: Mr. Rajnesh Jaiswal
Designation: PARR ToJaiswal Honourable Judge Date: 19/10/2023 18:31:30
